name: zsnd_wave_data_constructor_from_path
description: zSndWaveData::zSndWaveData duplicates the path, clears parse fields, and optionally loads the file.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 /MD byte verification for 0x4a53f0 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking; relocation bytes masked: 8.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a53f0 validates _strdup(path), zeroing parsedOk/fileSize/fileData/pcmByteCount/fmt/cuePointCount/cuePoints/pcmData, optional LoadAndParseIfNeeded when loadNow is nonzero, and returning self.
The native load/parse/reset smoke exercises the loadNow path through a temporary PCM RIFF file and verifies populated parsed wave fields.
The native edge smoke verifies the loadNow=0 path returns self, stores a duplicated path string, and clears all parse fields.
